swing_ideas.text: Simple range trading pre election and FOMC. Looking for the back to back hammers off of support to indicate buyers willing to rotate from 872 back up towards 912. Out of play if we take out Friday low.

Mild pullback among the broad market selling. If price can find buyers at the round 50 mark, looking for a Brigade Bolt™ higher low to offer the next base. Ideally target is all the way to 54.9 from the weekly chart. Not in play if price violates 50 with multiple daily closes below.

Flat top breakout in line with the daily 200 SMA (green). Not the best bar on Friday, but generally some relative strength to the broad market gap down on Thursday. Over 39.65 can target the origin of the breakdown at 42 area. Not in play if there is never a break over 39.65.

S&P hourly chart – Hourly chart shows some preliminary pathing ideas with the main outcomes looking at possible lower high weakness. For buyers to be back in control price needs a higher low over 579.75.

Market internals – Internals for the week really weren't all that bad. Thursday only saw strong volume outflows, but nothing substantial in the AD line or even the TICKs. Seems like profit taking and mild selling rather than outright "close all longs and lever up short."

Market profile – No follow through on Friday from the bears. Value is higher, and the PoC is also higher. Poor high could use some repair, so note that if we test Friday high, a break into the gap isn't unreasonable. The tell will be how much if any of it closes.
